label: timely=No; response-delay outcome, not actual escalation or fraud
sampling: First 4000 API results per half-year window, 2015–2017. Convenience sample, not population representative. Recent pilot had only 66 positives/16000 and was rejected.
feature_engineering: Stable SHA256 company category (16 hex characters); company identity is known before response, unlike outcome fields. No company response or response date features.
excluded: Narratives, company names, locations, personal fields and all response/resolution fields excluded from features
limitations: Historical US financial complaint domain only; no retail transfer or current risk calibration
